title: When AI becomes social: the promise and risks of AI companions for mental health – a social brain perspective
title_zh: 当 AI 变得社交：AI 伴侣对心理健康的前景与风险——来自社交大脑视角
abstract: AI companions are emerging as psychosocial technologies that may reshape social connection and mental health, while also creating risks of emotional dependence. Here, we propose a social-brain framework explaining how attachment, reward, and emotion regulation systems may shape human-AI bonding. This framework highlights the importance of understanding how AI companionship may reshape social connection and mental health, suggests an overarching model that accounts for the complex interplay between the human interface, technology design and context, and provides insights for the responsible design of future AI systems.
abstract_zh: AI 伴侣正在成为一种心理社会技术，可能重塑社会连接与心理健康，同时也带来情感依赖等风险。这里，我们提出一个社交大脑框架，以解释依恋、奖励和情绪调节系统如何塑造人类与 AI 的纽带。该框架强调了理解 AI 陪伴如何重塑社会连接与心理健康的重要性，提出了一个涵盖人机界面、技术设计和环境之间复杂相互作用的宏观模型，并为未来 AI 系统的负责任设计提供洞见。
